dephased.translation: a. 有相位差的, 相位移后的

dephlegmate.definition:
v. t. To deprive of superabundant water, as by
   evaporation or distillation; to clear of aqueous matter; to rectify; --
   used of spirits and acids.

dephlegmated.translation: vt. 使分馏；使分凝；除去…的过量水分

dephlegmating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Dephlegmate
dephlegmating.translation: vt. 使分馏；使分凝；除去…的过量水分

dephlegmation.definition:
n. The operation of separating water from spirits and
   acids, by evaporation or repeated distillation; -- called also
   concentration, especially when acids are the subject of it.
dephlegmation.translation:
[化] 分凝; 分凝作用
[医] 分溜, 分凝

dephlegmator.definition:
n. An instrument or apparatus in which water is
   separated by evaporation or distillation; the part of a distilling
   apparatus in which the separation of the vapors is effected.
dephlegmator.translation:
n. 分馏塔, 分凝器
[化] 分馏柱; 分馏塔; 分凝器

dephlogisticating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Dephlogisticcate

dephospho-coa pyrophosphorylase.translation: [化] 脱磷酸辅酶A焦磷酸化酶

dephosphorization.definition: n. The act of freeing from phosphorous.

dephosphorylated.translation: (dephosphorylate 的过去分词) 脱去磷酸

dephosphorylates.translation: (dephosphorylate 的第三人称 -s形式) 脱去磷酸

dephosphorylation.translation:
